en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Hammad, from Shuayb, from Abu Baseer, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘
Aqeeqa of the boy and the girl, is a ram’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Hammad ibn Shu’ayb from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
‘Aqiqah for a boy or a girl is one ram.’”
